research_mode: official MHCLG and ONS primary sources only; latest England fire-and-rescue statistics, CSEW quality/methodology and crime-statistics user-guide gates; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Two-source crime-statistics framework
verified_claims: Crime in England and Wales statistics primarily use the Crime Survey for England and Wales and police recorded crime
limitations: the two sources measure different concepts and must not be treated as interchangeable

sources.name: CSEW sample and mode
verified_claims: the CSEW is a face-to-face survey of around 31,000 people aged 16 years or over in England and Wales
limitations: the CSEW is sample-based rather than a census and is subject to sampling error

sources.name: Police recorded crime full-count scope
verified_claims: police recorded crime is a full count of notifiable crimes reported to and recorded by the police
limitations: the count excludes crimes not reported or not recorded and is not a full count of all crime

sources.name: Crime-statistics publication frequency
verified_claims: Crime in England and Wales statistics are produced quarterly
limitations: quarterly statistics are not a live incident feed

sources.name: CSEW twelve-month reference period
verified_claims: CSEW respondents are asked about crime experiences in the 12 months before interview
limitations: the retrospective reference period introduces recall and telescoping risks

sources.name: CSEW population and offence exclusions
verified_claims: the CSEW excludes crimes against businesses, people not resident in households, homicide and victimless offences such as drug possession
limitations: CSEW estimates cannot be used as a complete count of all crime or all populations

sources.name: CSEW provisional response-rate gate
verified_claims: the provisional CSEW response rate for the year ending March 2026 was 48%
limitations: the response rate is below historical levels and the published quality review should accompany use

sources.name: CSEW long-term trend series
verified_claims: CSEW estimates provide long-term trend information from the year ending December 1981 to the year ending March 2026
limitations: long-term comparisons must retain documented survey scope and methodology changes

sources.name: Police-force coverage gate
verified_claims: police recorded crime figures are supplied from 43 territorial police forces plus British Transport Police
limitations: force-area coverage does not identify the exact site of an offence

sources.name: Notifiable Offence List coverage gate
verified_claims: police recorded crime coverage is defined by the Notifiable Offence List and excludes non-notifiable offences such as anti-social behaviour and parking offences
limitations: police recorded crime totals should not be presented as covering all police incidents

sources.name: Police recorded crime accreditation limitation
verified_claims: police recorded crime data do not currently meet the required standard for accredited official statistics because of recording quality and consistency concerns
limitations: the data require explicit recording-practice caveats and should not be treated as error-free

sources.name: Combined-source incompleteness gate
verified_claims: CSEW and police recorded crime together provide a more comprehensive picture than either source alone
limitations: neither source provides a complete count of crime and both have exclusions

sources.name: Supplementary crime-source framework
verified_claims: the crime bulletin also uses Report Fraud, police anti-social-behaviour incidents and recorded non-notifiable offences
limitations: supplementary sources have different coverage and cannot be merged without source-specific definitions

sources.name: CSEW long-term reliability role
verified_claims: the CSEW is the most reliable indicator for long-term trends in common crimes experienced by the household population and includes unreported crimes
limitations: the reliability statement does not extend to excluded populations or very low-volume offences

sources.name: CSEW sampling and non-sampling error
verified_claims: CSEW estimates are subject to sampling error and non-sampling errors including recall issues
limitations: survey estimates must retain confidence intervals and quality caveats
